$comment: Agent knowledge (SPEC §12, #6): the always-on instructions and the switch for the skills (contrib/skills.json, generated from opentidehq/skills, holds the chatSkills). No chatPromptFiles: VS Code's docs say prompt files run only in Local harness sessions, which are to be removed in February 2027, and recommend skills instead; the opentide-rule skill covers a new detection rule.

enumDescriptions: Contribute the opentide skills to VS Code's agents, unless the opentidehq/skills Agent Plugin is installed and on, which supplies them.
Always contribute them, even beside the plugin.
opentide.agents.embeddedSkills.markdownDescription: Whether the extension contributes the opentide skills (from [opentidehq/skills](https://github.com/opentidehq/skills)) to VS Code's agents. With `auto` they are left out when the `opentide` Agent Plugin is installed and on (`chat.plugins.enabled`), which would load them as well. The extension sets that up when it activates, in a workspace with opentide content.
